back.target: dung, manure; (colloquial) rubbish, crap, nonsense; as an exclamation: damn!
back.example: What a load of crap! I missed the bus.

note: The hint is needed, because "rubbish" alone could mean der Müll and "crap" alone could mean Quatsch or Scheiße, and "mild" plus "shouted as Damn!" rules those out; also, in Austria der Mist is the everyday word for household rubbish (Mistkübel), but that doesn't change this meaning.
